senses.gloss: बाल- + अर्क बाल- + अर्क, m. the rising sun.
बल- + अर्थिन् बल- + अर्थिन्, adj. desiring power, Man. 2, 37.
बाल- + आतप बाल- + आतप, m. the rays of the rising sun, Man. 4, 69.
बल- + देव बल- + देव, see s. v.

बलदेव बलदेव, m.
 1. Air, wind.
 2. The elder brother of Kṛṣṇa.
बलि- + पुष्ट बलि- + पुष्ट, m. a crow.

† बल् बल्. i. 1, Par.
 1. To live.
 2. To hoard grain.
 --i. 10, Par.
 I. [] बालय (Caus.), To nourish.
 II. बलय, To live.
 --Cf. भल्.

बल बल,
 I. m.
 1. Baladeva.
 2. A crow, Chr. 24, 45.
 3. A demon.
 II. n.
 1. Strength, Hit. i. d. 191, M.M.; power, Pañc. 44, 14.
 2. An army, Hit. iv. d. 32.
 3. Bulkiness.
 4. The body.
 5. Rigour, violence; abl. बलात्, Forcibly, Vikr. 33, 2 (as if it was your intention); without, or against one's will, Chr. 77, 11; Pañc. 27, 10.
 III. f. ला, A plant, Sida cordifolia.
 --Comp.

बाल बाल,
 I. adj.
 1. Young, Vikr. d. 26.
 2. Ignorant, Pañc. 169, 16.
 II. m., and f. ला.
 1. A child (till sixteen years of age), Pañc. iv. d. 41; 219, 3; a foolish boy, Pañc. iv. d. 62.
 2. A colt.
 3. A five years' old elephant.
 4. A tail, Man. 8, 234.
 5. An elephant's or horse's tail, Rājat. 5, 386.
 6. Hair.
 III. m. and n. A perfume, Andropogon schoenanthus.
 IV. f. ला.
 1. A woman, Lass. 59, 10.
 2. Small cardamoms.
 V. f. ली, A sort of earring.
 --Comp.
बलाबल बलाबल, i. e. बल-अ-बल, n. strength and weakness, Hit. iii. d. 8.
बलभिद् बल-भिद्, m. Indra (the slayer of बल), Bhartṛ. 2, 85.
बलय बलय, see वलय.

बलवन्त् बल + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, comparat. बलीयंस्, superl. बलिष्ठ, strong, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 5; powerful, Chr. 35, 7; heavy, Vikr. 50, 8. बलीयंस्, Stronger, Pañc. iii. d. 7; बलीयस् + तर, much stronger, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 191. बलवत्, acc. sing. n., adv.
 1. Much, Vikr. 7, 9.
 2. Well, Śāk. d. 2.
बलाक बलाक, see वलाक.

बालक बाल + क,
 I. m.
 1. A boy, a child, Pañc. 238, 20; a young one, 49, 18; young, Pañc. i. d. 372 (just risen, viz. the sun).
 2. A foot.
 3. The tail of a horse or elephant.
 4. A finger ring.
 5. A perfume.
 II. f. लिका.
 1. A female infant.
 2. A woman, Pañc. iv. d. 62.
 3. Sand (perhaps erroneously for बालुक).

बलाकिन् बलाकिन्, i. e. बलाक + इन्,
 I. adj. Having cranes, Ragh. 11, 15.
 II. m. A proper name, Johns. Sel. 42, 58.
बलात्कार बलात्कार, i. e. बल + अत् (abl. of बल), -कार, m. Violence, Śāk. d. 173; Lass. 24, 19.

बलाहक बलाहक, also वला˚ वला˚, m.
 1. A cloud, MBh. 1, 1289; Śiś. 4, 54.
 2. A mountain.
 3. A Nāga.
 4. A demon, Draup. 2, 13.

बलि बलि (also वलि),
 I. m.
 1. A religious offering, Pañc. 199, 13.
 2. Presentation of food to all created beings; it consists in throwing a small parcel of the offering into the open air, Hit. ii. d. 41.
 3. Fragments of food left at an oblation, or a meal, Pañc. 114, 5.
 4. The sacrifice of an animal, sacrifice in general, Lass. 31, 7.
 5. An animal, or one which is fit for an oblation.
 6. Tax, royal revenue, Man. 7, 80; 9, 254; Pañc. 130, 17.
 7. The handle of a fly-flapper, Megh. 36.
 8. A king of the Daityas, also महाबलि, Johns. Sel. 95, 65; Pañc. iii. d. 268.
 II. f., also बली, and वलि.
 1. A wrinkle.
 2. The fold of skin upon the upper part of the belly, especially in females, Man. 6, 2; MBh. 1, 3467 (ई).
 3. The ridge of a thatch.
 --Comp.
बालि बालि, and बालिन् बालिन्, i. e. बाल + इन्, m. A monkey, the son of Indra.

बलिन् बलिन्, i. e. बल + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी, Strong, Pañc. i. d. 128.
 II. m.
 1. A bull.
 2. A camel.
 3. A hog.
 4. A name of Balarāma.
 5. A sort of pulse, Phaseolus radiatus.
 6. A sort of jasmine.
 III. f. नी, Sida cordifolia.
बलिन बलि + न, and बलिभ बलि + भ, adj. Wrinkled, shrivelled.
बलिष्ठ बलिष्ठ, and बलीयंस् बलीयंस्, see बलवन्त्.

बलीयस्त्व बलीयस्त्व, i. e. बलीयंस् + त्व, n.
 1. State of being very powerful, Hit. iv. d. 42.
 2. Excessive strength, Hit. iv. d. 125.
बलीवर्द बलीवर्द, m. An ox (cf. बलिन्), Pañc. i. d. 311.
बलीवर्ध बलीवर्ध, Hit. 57, 17 (corr. बलीवर्द).

† बल्ह् बल्ह्, or वल्ह् वल्ह्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To speak.
 2. To hurt.
 3. To give, or to cover.
 --i. 10, Par. To speak, to shine.
 --Cf. बर्ह् and वल्ह्.
बालखिल्य बाल-खिल्य (ved.), m. A divine personage of the size of the thumb, sixty thousand of whom were produced from the hair of Brahman's body, MBh. 13, 442; Sund. 3, 5.

बालधि बालधि, i. e. बाल-धा (see निधि), m. A hairy tail, Man. 4, 67.
 --Comp.

बालिश बालिश, derived from बाल, []
 I. adj.
 1. Young.
 2. Ignorant, foolish, Man. 3, 176; Pañc. i. d. 338.
 3. Careless.
 II. n. A pillow.
 --Comp.
बालिशता बालिश + ता, f. Childishness, foolishness, Utt. Rāmac. 147, 14.

बालिश्य बालिश्य, i. e. बालिश + य, n.
 1. Youth.
 2. Folly, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 8.
 3. Thoughtlessness.

बालुक बालुक, cf. बाल,
 I. m. A drug and perfume.
 II. f. का.
 1. Sand, Man. 8, 250; 12, 76; Pañc. 105, 8.
 2. Powder, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 13.
 3. Camphor.
 4. and ˚की की, also बालुङ्की बालुङ्की, बालुङ्गिका बालुङ्गिका, बालुङ्गी बालुङ्गी, A sort of cucumber.
 --Comp.

बालेय बालेय, i. e. बाल + एय,
 I. adj.
 1. Fit for a child.
 2. Soft.
 II. m.
 1. An ass.
 2. A demon.

बाल्य बाल्य, i. e. बाल + य, n.
 1. Childhood, Pañc. 219, 14.
 2. Youth, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 1.
 3. Foolishness, Draup. 5, 6.

बल- + भद्र बल- + भद्र,
 I. m. 1. Baladeva. 2. Ananta, the great serpent. 3. a strong man.
 II. f. रा, a young girl.
बाल- + भाव बाल- + भाव, m. youth, Pañc. 182, 12.
बलि- + मात्र बलि- + मात्र, n. even the offering called बलि, Pañc. 114, 5.
बलि- + मुख बलि- + मुख and बली-, m. a monkey.
बल- + राम बल- + राम, m. the third Rāma, the half-brother of Kṛṣṇa, MBh. 1, 7912.
बाल- + वैधव्य बाल- + वैधव्य, n. state of one who has become a widow already when a child, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 450.
बाल- + व्यजन बाल- + व्यजन, n. a fly-flapper used as an emblem of princely rank (made of the bushy tail of the Bos grunniens), Johns. Sel. 21, 102.
बल- + व्यसन बल- + व्यसन, n. defeat or rout of an army, Hit. iv. d. 32.
बल- + सूदन बल- + सूदन, m. a name of Indra, Lass. 50, 17.
